ExtraDock 4.2.3 – Folder Stacks & Widget Gallery! 📂✨

✨ What's New

  • Folder Stack Widget: Browse a folder of folders from a single dock icon! Customize the name, tint color, and choose which app opens the folders. Organize your projects, downloads, or any folder collection with one powerful widget!

⚡ What's Improved

  • Widget Gallery: The Add Widget screen is now a proper gallery — see what each widget does before adding it. No more guessing!
  • Instant Live Dock Changes: Live Dock changes now apply instantly — no restart or delay needed. What you change is what you get, right away!
  • Smarter Auto-Reveal: Auto-hide has been improved to trigger when your cursor is near the dock itself, not the entire screen edge. Much more precise and predictable!
  • Flawless Hover-to-Expand: Hover-to-expand has been completely reworked from the ground up — it now works flawlessly every time!

⚙️ Settings Overhaul

  • Reworked Settings: Everything now lives in its own correct category and section. Finding the setting you need has never been easier!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Dock Position Fix: Docks assigned to left/right (horizontal) or top/bottom (vertical) no longer incorrectly appear in the middle.
  • Trash Widget Fix: The Empty Trash action has been fixed for the Trash widget — works perfectly again!
  • Auto-Hide Stability: Auto-hidden docks no longer get stuck hidden after switching displays.
  • Respect Dock Space Fix: Fixed a hang caused by the Respect Dock Space feature.
  • Live Dock Default Fix: Live Dock no longer starts in Running Apps mode only to switch to Full Dock after a restart. It now defaults to Full Dock and stays that way unless you change it.

🗑️ Removed

  • Repair Folders Removed: The "Repair Folders" button has been removed — ExtraDock now repairs folders automatically to ensure they display correctly!

🚀 What's Next?

We're continuing to refine and expand ExtraDock with new widgets, smarter behaviors, and more customization options. Keep sharing your feedback — you're shaping the future of ExtraDock!

Thank you to the amazing ExtraDock community for your continued support. Every suggestion and bug report helps us build a better dock experience!

Want even more control over your workspace? Check out DockFlow to manage dock presets and create the perfect setup for every task!

And ExtraBar to create the ultimate menu bar that fits your workflow!
